note: evidence: The exact Qwen3 c3d placement child built the same f32-accumulator times f16-scale expression on A100 with an explicit conversion, and sm120 offers and realizes this reduced REDUCE=coop, WORK=t32 schedule before nvcc rejects only the emitted mixed-dtype expression.

attrs.body:
for a0 in 0..4:
    for a1 in 0..128:
        in0 = load x[a0, a1]
        acc0 <- add(acc0, in0) over a1
    in1 = load bias[a0, 0]
    in2 = load scale[a0, 0]
    v0 = multiply(acc0, in2)
    v1 = add(in1, v0)
    out[a0, 0] = v1
attrs.name: k_out_reduce
